measurement.method: gdb and /proc/<pid>/maps against the unstripped module

measurement.local_execution: these module offsets and the pad geometry below produced a command executed as uid 33 in a local php:8.5.11-apache lab

pad_geometry.fire_block_rule: for a leaked chunk H and delta D = libphp - H, the pad block is D - 0x1c00000 + pad_block_in_chunk

measurement.evidence: objleak lab and the local execution above; no target-written proof and no remote libphp leak on this build
